correctness.rationale: Exact first-return decomposition gives F=1+zF(F+t−1) and G=z[G(2F+t−1)+2zF_zF] for centered area. Formal coefficient extraction yields verified total and mixed moments; Narayana peak moments give the covariance and exact regression slope. Central-binomial inequality makes the sign strict for every n≥2. The n=1 boundary is exactly zero; Stirling gives both leading constants. An independent exact Prüfer-free excursion enumerator checks n≤12 (290511 paths). Unproved scope: nonlinear regression and any complete conditional distribution.

originality.rationale: Target is unrestricted uniform Dyck peak-count versus height-area mixed covariance and the sharp regression slope. Inspected closest primary full texts treat fixed-height peaks, local patterns, different noncrossing rank, or restricted-valley family marginals; none directly states or parameter-dominates this mixed formula. value.rationale: Peak number (local oscillation count) and height area (global excursion mass) are canonical but distinct observables in uniform Catalan paths. Their exact nonzero mixed law has a strict all-size negative sign and a sharp −2 sqrt(pi*n) least-squares slope, a natural dependence scale not recoverable from either marginal alone. The formula is useful as a finite-sample benchmark for geometric excursion prediction; no broad theorem or nonlinear-optimality claim is required.
